import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('scripts').resolve()))
from check_m3_update import fixture,run,snapshot
old=Path('/tmp/style-m3-complete-20261017/style-provider');cases=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='style-unknown-design-') as temp:
 root=Path(temp).resolve();env,home,codex,claude,stub=fixture(root)
 source=root/'source';source.mkdir();(source/'STYLE.yaml').write_text('spec: style/v0.3\nname: missing-model\nversion: 1.0.0\ndescription: compatibility probe\nreads: {model: true}\nrules:\n  - {id: r, target: event, event: tool.pre, when: {model: unknown}, text: UNKNOWN_CONTRACT_PROBE}\n')
 run(old,env,'install',source,'--harness','codex','--route','codex=codex-user','--yes','--json')
 index=home/'build/index.json';value=json.loads(index.read_text());assert value['format']==1;value['format']=4;index.write_text(json.dumps(value))
 for mode in ['missing','literal']:
  payload=dict(session_id='s',hook_event_name='PreToolUse',tool_name='Bash',tool_input={'command':'true'})
  if mode=='literal':payload['model']='unknown'
  p=root/'payload.json';p.write_text(json.dumps(payload));result=json.loads(run(old,env,'explain','--harness','codex','--event','PreToolUse','--payload',p,'--index',index,'--json').stdout)
  emitted='UNKNOWN_CONTRACT_PROBE' in result['wire']['stdout'];assert emitted==(mode=='literal')
  cases.append(dict(action='old-index4-'+mode,accepted=result['status']=='ok',emitted=emitted))
 before=snapshot(home,codex,claude)
 result=run(old,env,'sync','--json');after=json.loads(index.read_text());assert after['format']==1
 cases.append(dict(action='old-sync-downgrades-unmarked-index',before_format=4,after_format=after['format']))
 lock=home/'style.lock.yaml';text=lock.read_text().replace('format: 1','format: 2',1);lock.write_text('min_index_format: 5\n'+text)
 before=snapshot(home,codex,claude);blocked=run(old,env,'sync','--json',want=1);assert snapshot(home,codex,claude)==before
 cases.append(dict(action='strict-lock-marker-refuses-old-manager',exit=blocked.returncode,zero_write=True))
report=dict(format=1,task='M3-D6',amendment='unknown compatibility gate',date='2026-10-17',baseline='c865ef97ac05edf128d2bdb679ce5bd5dfe04366',old_binary_sha256=hashlib.sha256(old.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),cases=cases,probe_source=Path(__file__).read_text())
Path('docs/review/M3-D6-UNKNOWN-COMPAT-2026-10-17.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(cases))
